camel_example: aliyun paiautoml GET /api/automl/v1/hpo/experiment/abcde/trials --region cn-hangzhou --Order ASC --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy 'FINAL_METRIC_或着_CREATE_TIME' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Returns all the trials for the specified experiment ID
kebab_example: aliyun paiautoml list-hpo-trials --experiment-id abcde --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by 'FINAL_METRIC_或着_CREATE_TIME' --order ASC --region cn-hangzhou

additionalProperties.description_en: The details about the access denial

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This parameter is returned only if RAM permission verification failed
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息；只有Ram校验失败才会返回此字段

Code.description_en: The internal error code. This parameter is returned if an exception occurred
Code.description_zh: 内部错误码。只在响应出错时被设置

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned if an exception occurred
Message.description_zh: 响应错误信息。只在响应出错时被设置

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned. By default, this parameter is not returned
TotalCount.description_zh: TotalCount本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回

TotalCount.title_zh: TotalCount本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回

ExperimentId.description_en: The ID of the HPO experiment

FinalMetric.description_en: The final metric value calculated by the backend task after the trial is completed. The value is the value of the default key in the metric item of the FINAL type in the metric array
FinalMetric.description_zh: trial成功结束后，后台任务计算出的最终的metric值。来自metric数组里的FINAL 类型的metric项里的default key所对应的值

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time at which the trial was created. The time is in UTC

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The time at which the trial was last modified. The time is in UTC
GmtModifiedTime.description_zh: Trial 最后更新时间 UTC time

Hyperparam.description_en: The hyperparameter values of the trial

JobMeta.description_en: The meta information of the backend task to which the trial belongs. The value is in the JSON string format
JobMeta.description_zh: trial所对应的后台任务的meta信息。json string格式

Metric.description_en: The array of the results of the calculated metrics of the trial. The array includes one or more temporary values generated during the calculation and the final value
Metric.description_zh: trial计算metric的结果数组。包括一个或多个计算过程中产生的临时值，和一个最终值

Model.description_en: The storage location of the model generated by the backend task to which the trial belongs
Model.description_zh: 这个Trial 所对应的后台任务生成的模型的存储位置

ParameterId.description_en: The ID assigned by the backend task to which the trial belongs
ParameterId.description_zh: trail所对应的后台任务给这个trial分配的一个id
